Learned counsel for the applicant submits that   AJN  2/3 31 ABA-1765.22.odt has surfaced from the statement of co-accused, who has alleged that he was introduced to one Mustihar, who offered him to run his paan shop styled as Mustihar Paan Shop.

When a raid was conducted in the paan shop, goods worth Rs.2,490/- came to be seized, which is the prohibited substance not permitted to be sold/purchased in the State of Maharashtra in terms of the directions issued by the Commissioner, Konkan Division.
The co-accused in his statement led the investigation to the present applicant, as according to him, the present applicant is the supplier of prohibited substance to his paan shop.
3. From the FIR, it can be seen that on the very same day, the Food Safety Officer conducted raids on various paan kiosks and seized the prohibited substance.
However, as far as the induction of the present applicant is concerned, it is only at the instance of the person, who is running the Mustihar Paan Shop.

However,
since the statement of co-accused is to the effect that the product was sold to him by the applicant, he must report to the police station and co-operate in investigation.
Since the substance recovered is only for a minimal amount of Rs.2,490/-, the custodial interrogation of the applicant is not warranted.

Hence the following order:
 ORDER (a) In the event of arrest, the applicant - Javeed Salahuddin Khan shall be released on AJN 3/3 31 ABA-1765.22.odt temporary bail in C.R. No.I-145 of 2022 registered with Kongao Police Station,
District Thane on executing P.R. bond to the extent of Rs.25,000/- and furnishing one or two sureties of the like amount.
(b) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with facts of case and shall not tamper with prosecution evidence.

(c) The applicant shall report to the Kongao Police Station, Dist. Thane, on Thursdays and Fridays for two weeks and, thereafter, as and when directed by the Investigating Officer.
4.
List the application on 27/07/2022.
5. All parties are directed to act on the downloaded copy of the order supplied by the Advocate under his seal and signature.
